description: tlr1902 expression level and regulation in GSE94125 (axenic vs Meiothermus ruber co-culture)
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
url="https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE94nnn/GSE94125/suppl/GSE94125_T_Elongatus_Norm_Counts.csv.gz"
df=pd.read_csv(url, compression="gzip").set_index("Locus_Tag")
print("values look like log2-normalised counts: min %.2f max %.2f" % (df.values.min(), df.values.max()))
AX=[c for c in df.columns if c.endswith("_AX")]; CC=[c for c in df.columns if c.endswith("_CC")]
print("axenic n=%d, co-culture n=%d" % (len(AX), len(CC)))

g="tlr1902"
row=df.loc[g]
mean_all=df.mean(axis=1)
rank=(mean_all>mean_all[g]).sum()+1
pct=100*(mean_all<mean_all[g]).mean()
print("\n%s mean expression %.2f -> rank %d of %d (%.0fth percentile)" % (g, mean_all[g], rank, len(df), pct))
print("transcriptome mean %.2f, median %.2f" % (mean_all.mean(), mean_all.median()))

# AX vs CC for tlr1902 and its neighbours
print("\n%-10s %-28s  AX mean   CC mean   log2FC    t      p" % ("locus","annotation"))
ann={"tlr1900":"crtR beta-carotene hydroxylase","tlr1901":"ABC transporter ATPase",
     "tlr1902":"GH10 'xylanase'","tll1903":"unknown protein","tlr1904":"ABC transporter ATPase",
     "tll0007":"cellulose synthase","tlr1795":"cellulose synthase-like","tll1506":"rbcL"}
res=[]
for lg,a in ann.items():
    if lg not in df.index: print(lg,"absent"); continue
    x=df.loc[lg,AX].values.astype(float); y=df.loc[lg,CC].values.astype(float)
    t,p=stats.ttest_ind(y,x)
    res.append((lg,a,x.mean(),y.mean(),y.mean()-x.mean(),t,p))
    print("%-10s %-28s  %6.2f   %6.2f   %+6.2f  %6.2f  %.3f"%(lg,a,x.mean(),y.mean(),y.mean()-x.mean(),t,p))

# genome-wide AX vs CC to put tlr1902 in context
t_all,p_all=stats.ttest_ind(df[CC].values.astype(float), df[AX].values.astype(float), axis=1)
lfc=df[CC].mean(axis=1)-df[AX].mean(axis=1)
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
_,q,_,_=multipletests(np.nan_to_num(p_all,nan=1.0), method="fdr_bh")
qq=pd.Series(q,index=df.index)
print("\ngenes with FDR<0.05 in CC vs AX: %d / %d" % ((qq<0.05).sum(), len(qq)))
print("tlr1902: log2FC=%+.2f  raw p=%.3f  FDR q=%.3f" % (lfc[g], p_all[list(df.index).index(g)], qq[g]))

# correlation with neighbours across all 20 samples
for lg in ["tlr1901","tll1903","tlr1904","tlr1900"]:
    r,pr=stats.pearsonr(df.loc[g].astype(float), df.loc[lg].astype(float))
    print("corr(tlr1902, %s) r=%+.2f p=%.3f" % (lg, r, pr))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
ax[0].hist(mean_all, bins=60, color="#9bb8d3", edgecolor="white")
ax[0].axvline(mean_all[g], color="#c0392b", lw=2)
ax[0].text(mean_all[g]+0.2, ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.85, "tlr1902\n%.1f (%.0fth pct)"%(mean_all[g],pct), color="#c0392b", fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("mean normalised expression (log2)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("genes")
ax[0].set_title("tlr1902 sits in the bottom quartile of the\nT. vestitus BP-1 transcriptome (GSE94125)", fontsize=10)
lab=["axenic\n(n=%d)"%len(AX),"co-culture with\nM. ruber (n=%d)"%len(CC)]
vals=[df.loc[g,AX].astype(float).values, df.loc[g,CC].astype(float).values]
ax[1].boxplot(vals, labels=lab, widths=0.5)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[1].scatter(np.random.normal(i+1,0.05,len(v)), v, s=22, color="#c0392b", zorder=3)
ax[1].set_ylabel("tlr1902 normalised expression (log2)")
ax[1].set_title("tlr1902 is not induced by a heterotrophic partner\nlog2FC = %+.2f, FDR q = %.2f"%(lfc[g],qq[g]), fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
